for: research/session_scratchpad/shots_goals/protocol_shots.json (run dev and test on the same backend; record which in a hashed note before starting)
recorded: 2026-10-20, before any shot clip or window is processed for the shots phase

backend.where: private Kaggle kernels driven by the Kaggle API from this repo (research/session_scratchpad/kaggle/), no internet in the kernel
backend.image: Kaggle latest container image; torch 2.11.0+cu128 as measured in bench_v6.json
backend.precision: fp32 everywhere (no half / quantize); cudnn and matmul TF32 off
backend.players: the pipeline's player detection (yolov8s, imgsz 4096, the pipeline's own stride and thresholds) on cuda
backend.ball: detect_ball_heatmap.py --v2 with ball_v3b.1500.pt on cuda (load_v2 wrapped to move the model; repo code unchanged)
backend.after detection: static-point drop, linking, events and scoring run here on CPU from the returned files (cheap, deterministic)

scope: every dev clip and window and every M1 test clip and window is (re)processed on this backend; no CPU-produced player or ball file is reused in the shots phase
evidence the ball detector agrees with C: bench_v6.json: 320 / 320 candidates on 40 frames, max logit diff 5e-6, max position diff 0.0006 px
sealed matches: M7 / M9 clips are cut and unsealed here (VEO_UNSEAL never leaves this machine) and uploaded as clips to a private Kaggle dataset
